title: main.rs: owner_login WhoIs uses hardcoded port 443 instead of config.port
description: main.rs:96-99 builds the self-WhoIs SocketAddr with a hardcoded port :443 regardless of KITHD_PORT. When KITHD_PORT \!= 443, the SocketAddr passed to tailscaled is wrong. In practice tailscaled resolves identity by IP (port is ignored), so owner_login is still populated correctly — but the addr is misleading and would break if tailscaled ever validates ports. Fix: use config.port instead of the literal 443.
